{"items": [
{"type": "definition", "term": "Act", "text": "Act means the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974, as amended, enacted as section 444 of the General Education Provisions Act."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974", "cited_instrument": "FERPA (20 U.S.C. 1232g)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "General Education Provisions Act", "cited_instrument": "General Education Provisions Act"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Attendance", "text": "Attendance includes, but is not limited to—"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Authorized representative", "text": "Authorized representative means any entity or individual designated by a State or local educational authority or an agency headed by an official listed in § 99.31(a)(3) to conduct—with respect to Federal- or State-supported education programs—any audit or evaluation, or any compliance or enforcement activity in connection with Federal legal requirements that relate to these programs."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.31(a)(3)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.31(a)(3)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(1)(C), (b)(3), and (b)(5)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(1)(C), (b)(3), (b)(5)"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Biometric record", "text": "Biometric record, as used in the definition of personally identifiable information, means a record of one or more measurable biological or behavioral characteristics that can be used for automated recognition of an individual."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Dates of attendance", "text": "The term means the period of time during which a student attends or attended an educational agency or institution."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(5)(A)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(5)(A)"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Directory information", "text": "Directory information means information contained in an education record of a student that would not generally be considered harmful or an invasion of privacy if disclosed."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Disciplinary action or proceeding", "text": "Disciplinary action or proceeding means the investigation, adjudication, or imposition of sanctions by an educational agency or institution with respect to an infraction or violation of the internal rules of conduct applicable to students of the agency or institution."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Disclosure", "text": "Disclosure means to permit access to or the release, transfer, or other communication of personally identifiable information contained in education records by any means, including oral, written, or electronic means, to any party except the party identified as the party that provided or created the record."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(1) and (b)(2)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(1), (b)(2)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Head Start Act (42 U.S.C. 9831 et seq.)", "cited_instrument": "Head Start Act, 42 U.S.C. 9831 et seq."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "section 619 or part C of the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act", "cited_instrument": "Individuals with Disabilities Education Act"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Educational agency or institution", "text": "Educational agency or institution means any public or private agency or institution to which this part applies under § 99.1(a)."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.1(a)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.1(a)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(3)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(3)"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Education program", "text": "Education program means any program that is principally engaged in the provision of education, including, but not limited to, early childhood education, elementary and secondary education, postsecondary education, special education, job training, career and technical education, and adult education, and any program that is administered by an educational agency or institution."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(3), (b)(5)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(3), (b)(5)"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Education records", "text": "The term means those records that are:"}
]}

{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An educational agency or institution shall give full rights under the Act to either parent, unless the agency or institution has been provided with evidence that there is a court order, State statute, or legally binding document relating to such matters as divorce, separation, or custody that specifically revokes these rights.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "An educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "unless the agency or institution has been provided with evidence that there is a court order, State statute, or legally binding document relating to such matters as divorce, separation, or custody that specifically revokes these rights"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "the Act", "cited_instrument": "Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (20 U.S.C. 1232g)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Nothing in this section prevents an educational agency or institution from disclosing education records, or personally identifiable information from education records, to a parent without the prior written consent of an eligible student if the disclosure meets the conditions in § 99.31(a)(8), § 99.31(a)(10), § 99.31(a)(15), or any other provision in § 99.31(a).", "force": "permission", "binds": "an educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "if the disclosure meets the conditions in § 99.31(a)(8), § 99.31(a)(10), § 99.31(a)(15), or any other provision in § 99.31(a)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.31(a)(8)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.31(a)(8)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.31(a)(10)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.31(a)(10)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.31(a)(15)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.31(a)(15)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The Act and this part do not prevent educational agencies or institutions from giving students rights in addition to those given to parents.", "force": "permission", "binds": "educational agencies or institutions", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(d)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(d)"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "eligible student", "text": "When a student becomes an eligible student, the rights accorded to, and consent required of, parents under this part transfer from the parents to the student."},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Each educational agency or institution shall annually notify parents of students currently in attendance, or eligible students currently in attendance, of their rights under the Act and this part.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Each educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "annually"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The notice must inform parents or eligible students that they have the right to—", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The notice", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.31", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.31"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§§ 99.63 and 99.64", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.63 and 99.64"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The notice must include all of the following:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The notice", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.20", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.20"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An educational agency or institution may provide this notice by any means that are reasonably likely to inform the parents or eligible students of their rights.", "force": "permission", "binds": "An educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "by any means that are reasonably likely to inform the parents or eligible students of their rights"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An educational agency or institution shall effectively notify parents or eligible students who are disabled.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "An educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An agency or institution of elementary or secondary education shall effectively notify parents who have a primary or home language other than English.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "An agency or institution of elementary or secondary education", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g (e) and (f)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(e) and (f)"}
]}

{"items":[{"type":"definition","term":"Eligible student","text":"Eligible student means a student who has reached 18 years of age or is attending an institution of postsecondary education."},{"type":"definition","term":"Institution of postsecondary education","text":"Institution of postsecondary education means an institution that provides education to students beyond the secondary school level; “secondary school level” means the educational level (not beyond grade 12) at which secondary education is provided as determined under State law."},{"type":"definition","term":"Parent","text":"Parent means a parent of a student and includes a natural parent, a guardian, or an individual acting as a parent in the absence of a parent or a guardian."},{"type":"definition","term":"Party","text":"Party means an individual, agency, institution, or organization."},{"type":"definition","term":"Personally Identifiable Information","text":"The term includes, but is not limited to—"},{"type":"definition","term":"Record","text":"Record means any information recorded in any way, including, but not limited to, handwriting, print, computer media, video or audio tape, film, microfilm, and microfiche."},{"type":"definition","term":"Secretary","text":"Secretary means the Secretary of the U.S. Department of Education or an official or employee of the Department of Education acting for the Secretary under a delegation of authority."},{"type":"definition","term":"Student","text":"Student, except as otherwise specifically provided in this part, means any individual who is or has been in attendance at an educational agency or institution and regarding whom the agency or institution maintains education records."},{"type":"definition","term":"treatment","text":"For the purpose of this definition, “treatment” does not include remedial educational activities or activities that are part of the program of instruction at the agency or institution"},{"type":"reference","text":"§ 99.8","cited_instrument":"34 CFR 99.8"},{"type":"reference","text":"20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(4)","cited_instrument":"20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(4)"},{"type":"reference","text":"20 U.S.C. 1232g(d)","cited_instrument":"20 U.S.C. 1232g(d)"},{"type":"reference","text":"20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(4)(A)","cited_instrument":"20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(4)(A)"},{"type":"reference","text":"20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(6)","cited_instrument":"20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(6)"}]}

{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An educational agency or institution shall give a parent or eligible student, on request, an opportunity for a hearing to challenge the content of the student's education records on the grounds that the information contained in the education records is inaccurate, misleading, or in violation of the privacy rights of the student.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "An educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "on request"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If, as a result of the hearing, the educational agency or institution decides that the information is inaccurate, misleading, or otherwise in violation of the privacy rights of the student, it shall: (i) Amend the record accordingly;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(ii) Inform the parent or eligible student of the amendment in writing.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "in writing"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If, as a result of the hearing, the educational agency or institution decides that the information in the education record is not inaccurate, misleading, or otherwise in violation of the privacy rights of the student, it shall inform the parent or eligible student of the right to place a statement in the record commenting on the contested information in the record or stating why he or she disagrees with the decision of the agency or institution, or both.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(1) Maintain the statement with the contested part of the record for as long as the record is maintained;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "for as long as the record is maintained"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(2) Disclose the statement whenever it discloses the portion of the record to which the statement relates.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "whenever it discloses the portion of the record to which the statement relates"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(2)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(a)(2)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "paragraph (b)(2) of this section", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.21(b)(2)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The hearing required by § 99.21 must meet, at a minimum, the following requirements:", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The educational agency or institution shall hold the hearing within a reasonable time after it has received the request for the hearing from the parent or eligible student.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "within a reasonable time after it has received the request for the hearing from the parent or eligible student"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The educational agency or institution shall give the parent or eligible student notice of the date, time, and place, reasonably in advance of the hearing.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "reasonably in advance of the hearing"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The hearing may be conducted by any individual, including an official of the educational agency or institution, who does not have a direct interest in the outcome of the hearing.", "force": "permission", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The educational agency or institution shall give the parent or eligible student a full and fair opportunity to present evidence relevant to the issues raised under § 99.21.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The parent or eligible student may, at their own expense, be assisted or represented by one or more individuals of his or her own choice, including an attorney.", "force": "permission", "binds": "The parent or eligible student", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "at their own expense"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The educational agency or institution shall make its decision in writing within a reasonable period of time after the hearing.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "within a reasonable period of time after the hearing"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The decision must be based solely on the evidence presented at the hearing, and must include a summary of the evidence and the reasons for the decision.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.21", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.21"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "53 FR 11943", "cited_instrument": "53 FR 11943"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "61 FR 59296", "cited_instrument": "61 FR 59296"}
]}

{"items": [
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.31(a)(3)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.31(a)(3)"},
{"type": "permission", "text": "Authorized representatives of the officials or agencies headed by officials listed in § 99.31(a)(3) may have access to education records in connection with an audit or evaluation of Federal or State supported education programs, or for the enforcement of or compliance with Federal legal requirements that relate to those programs.", "force": "permission", "binds": "Authorized representatives of the officials or agencies headed by officials listed in § 99.31(a)(3)", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in § 99.31(a)(3) is responsible for using reasonable methods to ensure to the greatest extent practicable that any entity or individual designated as its authorized representative—", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in § 99.31(a)(3)", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "using reasonable methods"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in § 99.31(a)(3) must use a written agreement to designate any authorized representative, other than an employee.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in § 99.31(a)(3)", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "a written agreement"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The written agreement must—", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The written agreement", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Information that is collected under paragraph (a) of this section must—", "force": "obligation", "binds": "Information that is collected under paragraph (a) of this section", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "permission", "text": "except that the State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in § 99.31(a)(3) may make further disclosures of personally identifiable information from education records on behalf of the educational agency or institution in accordance with the requirements of § 99.33(b)", "force": "permission", "binds": "the State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in § 99.31(a)(3)", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "in accordance with the requirements of § 99.33(b)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.33(b)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.33(b)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.30", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.30"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1232g(b)(1)(C), (b)(3), and (b)(5)", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1232g"}
]}

{"type": "obligation", "text": "Nothing in the Act or this part prevents a State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section from entering into agreements with organizations conducting studies under paragraph (a)(6)(i) of this section and redisclosing personally identifiable information from education records on behalf of educational agencies and institutions that disclosed the information to the State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section in accordance with the requirements of § 99.33(b).", "force": "permission", "binds": "a State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "in accordance with the requirements of § 99.33(b)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.33(b)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.33(b)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An educational agency or institution may disclose personally identifiable information under paragraph (a)(6)(i) of this section, and a State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section may redisclose personally identifiable information under paragraph (a)(6)(i) and (a)(6)(ii) of this section, only if—", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "An educational agency or institution; a State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "only if—"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The study is conducted in a manner that does not permit personal identification of parents and students by individuals other than representatives of the organization that have legitimate interests in the information;", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The information is destroyed when no longer needed for the purposes for which the study was conducted; and", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "when no longer needed for the purposes for which the study was conducted"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The educational agency or institution or the State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section enters into a written agreement with the organization that—", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The educational agency or institution or the State or local educational authority or agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "written agreement"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Specifies the purpose, scope, and duration of the study or studies and the information to be disclosed;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the written agreement", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "written agreement"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Requires the organization to use personally identifiable information from education records only to meet the purpose or purposes of the study as stated in the written agreement;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the organization", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "written agreement"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Requires the organization to conduct the study in a manner that does not permit personal identification of parents and students, as defined in this part, by anyone other than representatives of the organization with legitimate interests;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the organization", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "written agreement"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Requires the organization to destroy all personally identifiable information when the information is no longer needed for the purposes for which the study was conducted and specifies the time period in which the information must be destroyed.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the organization", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "specifies the time period in which the information must be destroyed"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An educational agency or institution or State or local educational authority or Federal agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section is not required to initiate a study or agree with or endorse the conclusions or results of the study.", "force": "permission", "binds": "An educational agency or institution or State or local educational authority or Federal agency headed by an official listed in paragraph (a)(3) of this section", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "definition", "term": "organization", "text": "For the purposes of paragraph (a)(6) of this section, the term organization includes, but is not limited to, Federal, State, and local agencies, and independent organizations."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.3", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.3"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "section 152 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986", "cited_instrument": "26 U.S.C. 152"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The educational agency or institution may disclose information under paragraph (a)(9)(i) of this section only if the agency or institution makes a reasonable effort to notify the parent or eligible student of the order or subpoena in advance of compliance, so that the parent or eligible student may seek protective action, unless the disclosure is in compliance with—", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "The educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "makes a reasonable effort to notify the parent or eligible student of the order or subpoena in advance of compliance"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "18 U.S.C. 2332b(g)(5)(B)", "cited_instrument": "18 U.S.C. 2332b(g)(5)(B)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "18 U.S.C. 2331", "cited_instrument": "18 U.S.C. 2331"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If an educational agency or institution initiates legal action against a parent or student, the educational agency or institution may disclose to the court, without a court order or subpoena, the education records of the student that are relevant for the educational agency or institution to proceed with the legal action as plaintiff.", "force": "permission", "binds": "the educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If a parent or eligible student initiates legal action against an educational agency or institution, the educational agency or institution may disclose to the court, without a court order or subpoena, the student's education records that are relevant for the educational agency or institution to defend itself.", "force": "permission", "binds": "the educational agency or institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.36", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.36"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.37", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.37"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 99.39", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 99.39"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The disclosure may only include the final results of the disciplinary proceeding conducted by the institution of postsecondary education with respect to that alleged crime or offense.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The institution may disclose the final results of the disciplinary proceeding, regardless of whether the institution concluded a violation was committed.", "force": "permission", "binds": "The institution", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
